name: Dorian LPG Ltd.
tagline: Leading VLGC owner and operator focused on maximizing shareholder value through strategic fleet deployment
hero_kpi_rationale: Le segment Helios Pool représente 97% du revenu total en 2025, démontrant la concentration stratégique de la flotte de 25 VLGCs dans ce pool commercial opérationnel depuis avril 2015

kpis.explanation: Proportion of total revenues generated through Helios Pool operations
kpis.description: All 25 VLGCs deployed in Helios Pool as of May 23, 2025, with revenue concentration growing from 94% (2023) to 97% (2025)
kpis._validation: Corrected value from string '97% du revenu total' to numeric 97; changed unit to %; updated yoy from 'stable' to 'up' based on historical trend; removed generic status; improved name_fr to reflect concentration metric

kpis.name_fr: Taille de la flotte de VLGCs

kpis.description: Fleet comprises 25 VLGCs including 1 Dual-fuel ECO, 19 ECO VLGCs, 1 modern VLGC, 3 time-chartered Dual-fuel ECO Panamax, and 1 time-chartered ECO VLGC. One newbuilding VLGC/AC ordered for Q2 2026 delivery
kpis._validation: Changed unit from 'navires' to 'vessels' for consistency; updated name_fr for clarity; improved description with fleet composition details; removed generic status

stories_kpis.name_fr: Concentration du revenu dans le pool Helios en 2025
stories_kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenues from all-fleet deployment in Helios Pool
stories_kpis.signal: Complete fleet deployment in pool operations
stories_kpis.description: All 25 VLGCs deployed in Helios Pool as of May 23, 2025, representing 97% of total revenues with upward trajectory from 94% (2023) and 95% (2024)
stories_kpis._validation: Corrected value from string to numeric 97; changed yoy to 'up' reflecting growth trend; expanded history from single point [97] to full 3-year trend [94,95,97]; marked is_wow as true due to strategic significance; improved name_fr and description

ai_positioning.summary: Dorian LPG Ltd. does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025

risks.title: Fuel Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Form 10-K explicitly states 'Changes in fuel, or bunker, prices may adversely affect profits.' This is identified as a direct operational cost risk with significant impact on profitability.
risks.summary: Fluctuations in bunker fuel prices can materially impact vessel operating expenses and overall profitability

risks.title: Crew Cost Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Form 10-K notes LPG transportation specialization creates increased demand for qualified crew, creating inflationary pressure on crew costs. However, management indicates costs can be controlled during downturns.
risks.summary: Specialized crew requirements and increased demand for qualified personnel put upward pressure on vessel operating costs, though mitigation is possible in downturns

risks.title: VLGC Fleet Capacity Growth
risks.score_rationale: Form 10-K states 'the number of vessels is increasing' in LPG transportation, creating increased supply-side competition that can pressure freight rates and market share.
risks.summary: Expansion of global VLGC fleet capacity increases competitive pressure on freight rates and vessel utilization rates

risks.title: LPG Shipping Demand Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Company operates exclusively in LPG shipping with no industry diversification. Form 10-K emphasizes dependency on demand/supply levels in specialized shipping sector with cyclical characteristics.
risks.summary: High dependency on LPG shipping demand levels due to lack of business diversification exposes company to sector-specific cyclical downturns

risks.title: Operational and Maritime Risks
risks.score_rationale: VLGC operations involve technical and safety risks including vessel maintenance, drydock requirements, and maritime incidents that can impact availability and financial performance.
risks.summary: Specialized VLGC operations carry inherent risks including maintenance requirements, drydock downtime, and maritime operational hazards affecting fleet availability
